scenes.title: An eye opens upon a world
The Śaiva genealogy: measure, dream, crystal
The frame calls its boundary the horizon
The Other interrupts — regard, context, refraction

expression:return-of-zero:roz-mytheme-ma.title: the eye — its condition already at work in what appears
the blindside — constitutive, more than the anatomical spot
the frame — productive exclusion, a determinate appearance
the horizon — the field of coming-forward, changed by walking and reply
Anuttara/Paramaśiva — the unobjectifiable ground
Śakti — manifestation and self-articulation; prakāśa–vimarśa together
Māyā — measure: this appears, that is withheld; the five kañcukas
paśu — the bounded knower; buddhi, ahaṃkāra, manas
the dream — sleep disappearing from the experienced situation
the crystal — display without knowing; the mirror that also generates its appearances
x acting as X — the local 1 claiming the 0 on which it depends
the prepared role — words becoming further evidence of what the frame knew
the complex — investment colouring perception confirming the image
the nested relay — model, action, changed world, model; capture when results erase their status as results
Bratton p.25 §§5.1–5.3 — the relay's distinct temporal tasks
the Other's refusal — the excess that can alter the measure of the encounter
the 180°→360° turn — perspectives and transitions held in context
the stained window — panes, seams, changing projection; Bimba/QL/MEF/pratibimba assigned
the holographic unit — the whole descent carried through one local unit
Watson/Gans/Levinas — the face-to-face exceeding the image held of the Other
the veil — seen as Śakti, not as hole; Māyā the measure wound around the opening Anuttara owns
the opening — never one more bounded patch
A24 — necessary measuring preserved; usurped measure made answerable
the paśu correction — the "I am" preceding separation; the bounded position arising within recognition's field
A35/A36 — the eye opens again; recognition lived in the next seeing
